scope: Cross-ledger material change, calendar-write and notification deduplication for Fortnite France/Europe
purpose: Persist exactly which semantic changes have already been observed, projected and/or notified so hourly monitoring remains restart-safe and does not repeat alerts.

delivery_semantics.rule: A notification_key is permanently consumed as soon as its receipt enters RESERVED. SENT confirms delivery attempt completion, but RESERVED/UNKNOWN_DELIVERY are also dedupe terminal for automatic resend.
delivery_semantics.crash_policy: If execution crashes after reservation and delivery cannot be proven, transition to UNKNOWN_DELIVERY on recovery and do not automatically resend. Manual recovery or explicit proof of non-delivery is required to reuse the same logical alert.
delivery_semantics.reason: Avoid duplicate user notifications across restarts, retries, partial failures and repeated crawls even at the cost of a rare missed alert.

bootstrap.policy: All semantic state already present in the baseline manifest is treated as known and must not generate a new notification merely because the change ledger is new, the monitor restarts, or the same facts are rediscovered. Only a material semantic delta after baseline may create a new change_id/notification_key.

normalization: sort set-like arrays by stable ID/value before hashing
preserve ordered arrays only when order has business meaning
normalize equivalent timezone-aware instants to RFC3339 UTC for hashing while retaining source timezone in the canonical ledger
normalize null and UNKNOWN distinctly when domain semantics distinguish them
strip URL tracking parameters only when they are not identity-bearing
semantic_fingerprint_policy.evidence_rule: A source/evidence change is material only when it changes authority, confidence, official finality, territory applicability or the supported business fact. Merely re-fetching the same source is not material.

key_policy.subject_key: Use the most stable logical ID available: service_event_id, track_id/milestone_id, competition_id/phase_id/session_id, participant_id+route_id, physical_event_id/access_profile_id, event_uid+provider/session/category, lore claim_id, candidate_id or calendar UID.
key_policy.scope_key: Optional stable sub-scope such as phase/session/category/window/component/participant/route. Never use crawl timestamp as scope.

notification_protocol.eligibility: Domain-specific engines decide whether a change is worth notifying. This ledger never upgrades a silent change into an alert by itself.
steps: 1_DETECT: compute semantic fingerprint from canonical pre/post facts.
2_DEDUPE_CHANGE: if identical change_id or semantic fingerprint for same subject/scope already exists, stop; no new change, commit or notification.
3_APPEND_CHANGE: append immutable change record before any user notification.
4_BUILD_NOTIFICATION_KEY: derive stable key without timestamps that are not part of the business fact.
5_CHECK_RECEIPTS: if key exists in SUPPRESSED_BASELINE, SUPPRESSED_POLICY, RESERVED, SENT or UNKNOWN_DELIVERY, do not notify again.
6_RESERVE: append/update a notification receipt to RESERVED and persist it BEFORE emitting the user-visible notification.
7_EMIT_ONCE: emit at most one notification for the reserved key/group.
8_CONFIRM: after emission, transition receipt RESERVED -> SENT with sent_at and delivery_fingerprint when possible.
9_RECOVERY: stale RESERVED without proof becomes UNKNOWN_DELIVERY, never automatic resend.

reservation.same_key_parallel_runs: Only the first persisted reservation wins; subsequent runs suppress themselves after fresh-reading the ledger.

coalescing.rule: Before reservation, multiple materially related changes for the same logical subject may be grouped into one notification_group_key. Preserve all member change_ids in the receipt.
do_not_merge: a cancellation with a later reactivation
different ticketing events merely occurring near each other

restart_and_retry_policy.fresh_read_required: Every run must fresh-read fortnite-change-ledger.json immediately before reserving a notification or recording a write receipt.
restart_and_retry_policy.idempotency: Reprocessing the same official page, Git commit, ledger history event or calendar projection must converge to the same change_id/notification_key.
restart_and_retry_policy.out_of_order: If an older fact arrives after a newer canonical state, store it only if domain history requires it; do not emit a stale notification unless a domain engine explicitly classifies it as an actionable official correction.
restart_and_retry_policy.clock_independence: Detection time is audit metadata and never part of the semantic dedupe fingerprint unless the official business fact itself is a timestamp change.

calendar_and_commit_dedupe.rule: Notification dedupe and repository-write dedupe are separate. A change may require a calendar commit but no alert, or an alert but no calendar change.
calendar_and_commit_dedupe.calendar_projection: Before writing an ICS VEVENT, compute projected_business_fingerprint excluding DTSTAMP, LAST-MODIFIED, folding and badge expiry. If calendar_write_key is already COMMITTED or current VEVENT fingerprint is identical, skip the write and do not increment SEQUENCE.
calendar_and_commit_dedupe.ledger_write: Before rewriting a canonical ledger for a fact already represented identically, compare semantic fingerprint; unchanged facts produce no Git write even if checked_at changed.
calendar_and_commit_dedupe.unknown_commit_state: If a process crashes after Git write may have succeeded, fresh-fetch the target file and compare semantic fingerprint before retrying. Never retry blindly.

correction_and_supersession.rule: A genuine official correction is a new semantic change and may notify once even if the same subject was notified earlier.
correction_and_supersession.supersedes: Use supersedes_change_id when the new change explicitly corrects/replaces an earlier material fact. Never delete the prior record or receipt.
correction_and_supersession.reversion: A later return to an earlier value is still a new change only when supported by a new official transition/evidence, not when caused by stale source ordering.

retention.change_records: Keep active/recent change records in this ledger. Older records may later move to an archive file without losing notification dedupe keys.
retention.notification_keys: Never discard a consumed notification_key solely because it is old. If archival is introduced, persist exact dedupe tombstones permanently or for the full useful lifetime of the logical subject.
retention.write_keys: Calendar/ledger write receipts may be compacted after the underlying canonical file has moved beyond the old semantic state, but notification keys remain stronger retention data.

history.note: Existing Fortnite canonical ledgers and calendar projections were imported as silent baseline state. No pre-bootstrap fact should generate an alert solely because this dedupe ledger was introduced.
